name: netagiri
description: NETAGIRI: Parliament Under Siege — multiplayer social-deduction browser game

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.preview:emergent: concurrently -k -n server,client -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "PORT=3000 npm run dev -w client -- --strictPort"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
